# AI Agents Accessible APIs — full list (301 services, verified 2026-09-24)
# format: name | what it does | auth (hint) | mcp | free tier | docs

## Web search [web-search]
- Brave Search API | Lets an agent query Brave's independent web/image/video/news search index and get cited, LLM-ready results. | auth:api_key (X-Subscription-Token: <API_KEY>) | mcp:official https://github.com/brave/brave-search-mcp-server | $5 free monthly credits (~1,000 queries on Search plan); credit card required at signup as anti-fraud measure | https://api-dashboard.search.brave.com/app/documentation/web-search/get-started | note: Official MCP server (@brave/brave-search-mcp-server) is self-hosted only via npx/Docker/HTTP transport, no vendor-hosted remote endpoint found; Answers plan is separate ($4/1,000 req + token costs).
- Exa | Lets an agent run neural or keyword web search, retrieve page contents, and find similar links via Exa's API. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer <EXA_API_KEY> (or x-api-key header)) | mcp:official https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp | free tier: $10 free credits/month (~1,400 searches), no payment method required | https://docs.exa.ai/reference/getting-started | note: Remote MCP endpoint requires no API key to start; self-hosted npm package (exa-mcp-server) also available.
- Jina AI Search / Reader | Search the web or convert any URL into clean LLM-ready markdown via simple HTTP GET requests. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer <JINA_API_KEY> (works without a key too, but at a lower rate limit)) | mcp:none | no key needed: 100 RPM (s.jina.ai search) / 500 RPM (r.jina.ai reader); free API key raises limits to 1,000/5,000 RPM with token-based billing | https://docs.jina.ai | note: Usable without an API key at reduced rate limits; interactive docs/playground at https://api.jina.ai/scalar. No official MCP server found.
- Kagi Search API | Run programmatic, ad-free premium web/news/image/video searches and extract page markdown via a paid REST API. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bot <token>) | mcp:official https://github.com/kagisearch/kagimcp | no free tier: pay-per-use, $12 per 1,000 search requests, invoiced monthly or at $100 usage, whichever first | https://help.kagi.com/kagi/api/overview.html | note: Requires a funded/billed Kagi account; on Family/Team plans only the account owner can access the API portal. Official hosted MCP endpoint also available at https://mcp.kagi.com/mcp using just an API key.
- Linkup | Lets an agent search, fetch pages, or run deep multi-source research via Linkup's Search/Fetch/Research API endpoints. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer <LINKUP_API_KEY>) | mcp:official https://mcp.linkup.so/mcp | $20 free credits/month for new accounts signing up with a professional email | https://docs.linkup.so/pages/documentation/endpoints/search/reference | note: Also supports the x402 protocol: pay-per-request in USDC on Base with no account required; Extract endpoint is in closed beta; MCP endpoint also supports ?apiKey= query param auth.
- Mojeek Search API | Query Mojeek's independent web index for titles, URLs and snippets in JSON or XML, with country/language boosting. | auth:api_key (check docs (exact query-param name obtained after contacting Mojeek for a plan)) | mcp:none | limited-query free trial available on request; paid plans from £2 CPM (Startup, 5 req/s, 100k/day cap) | https://www.mojeek.com/support/api/search/ | note: Sign-up is not instant self-serve, requires contacting Mojeek via their contact form to get a key/plan (Startup/Business/Enterprise). Independent (non-Google/Bing-derived) index.
- Parallel Web Systems Search API | Lets an agent run Parallel's low-latency Search API for web research, content extraction, and entity discovery. | auth:api_key (x-api-key: <PARALLEL_API_KEY>) | mcp:official https://search.parallel.ai/mcp | free: 5,000 requests/month across APIs, plus up to $80 signup credit and $5/month free credits | https://docs.parallel.ai | note: The remote MCP server is free and requires no account/API key; the main REST API requires an API key from the dashboard.
- Perplexity Sonar / Search API | Lets an agent call Perplexity's Search API or MCP tools (search/ask/research/reason) for real-time grounded web answers. | auth:api_key+oauth2 (Authorization: Bearer <PERPLEXITY_API_KEY> (remote MCP also supports OAuth sign-in)) | mcp:official https://api.perplexity.ai/mcp | no confirmed free tier; pay-as-you-go, Search API billed at $5 per 1,000 requests | https://docs.perplexity.ai/api-reference/search-post | note: Sonar Chat Completions endpoint is being migrated to the new Agent API with a migration deadline around 2026-09-27; platform now exposes four APIs: Search, Router, Agent, Embeddings.
- SearchApi.io | Fetch structured JSON results from Google, Bing, YouTube, Amazon, TikTok and 50+ other search engines via one REST API. | auth:api_key (api_key=<KEY> as query param, or Authorization: Bearer <KEY>) | mcp:none | 100 free requests, no credit card required; then paid plans from $40/mo (10,000 searches) | https://www.searchapi.io/docs/google | note: Separate OpenAPI spec per engine (e.g. /openapi/google.yaml); no official MCP server found.
- SearXNG (self-hosted JSON API) | Query a self-hosted SearXNG metasearch instance's JSON API to aggregate results from many search engines at once. | auth:none (none by default; self-hosted instance owner controls access (can add auth/proxy in front)) | mcp:community https://github.com/ihor-sokoliuk/mcp-searxng | free, no key (self-hosted; you run and pay for the instance yourself) | https://docs.searxng.org/dev/search_api.html | note: Not a vendor with a signup/API key, it's open-source software you self-host (or point at a trusted public instance from searx.space). JSON/CSV/RSS output formats must be explicitly enabled by the instance admin in settings.yml (search.formats); most public instances disable JSON and return 403. Included because it gives agents a genuine no-signup programmatic search interface once deployed.
- SerpApi | Lets an agent scrape structured JSON results from Google and 20+ other search engines via SerpApi's REST API. | auth:api_key (api_key query parameter (also usable as header depending on client library)) | mcp:official https://github.com/serpapi/serpapi-mcp | free plan: 250 searches/month, 50 requests/hour throughput | https://serpapi.com/search-api | note: Cached searches are free and don't count toward the monthly search quota.
- Serper | Lets an agent fetch fast, low-cost Google search results (web, images, news, maps, shopping) via Serper's REST API. | auth:api_key (X-API-KEY header (per widely published examples; could not independently re-confirm via automated fetch, see notes)) | mcp:community https://github.com/marcopesani/mcp-server-serper | free tier: 2,500 queries, no credit card required | https://serper.dev | note: serper.dev's docs/playground is a JS-rendered, login-gated SPA so automated fetch could not fully re-verify all details beyond the public marketing page (2,500 free queries confirmed there). No official MCP server found; listed repo is the most-starred community one.
- Tavily | Lets an agent call Tavily's search API or MCP server to run web searches and get AI-ready summarized results. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer tvly-<API_KEY>) | mcp:official https://mcp.tavily.com/mcp/ | free tier: 1,000 API credits/month, no credit card required | https://docs.tavily.com/documentation/api-reference/endpoint/search | note: Advanced search depth costs 2 credits vs 1 for basic/fast; remote MCP server supports both API key and OAuth authentication; repo: github.com/tavily-ai/tavily-mcp.
- You.com API | Lets an agent call You.com's Search/Answer/Research API or MCP server for LLM-ready web search and grounded answers. | auth:api_key (X-API-Key header (or YDC_API_KEY env var)) | mcp:official https://api.you.com/mcp | free credits on signup via you.com/platform; free search profile also available through the keyless Docs MCP server | https://you.com/docs/api-reference/search | note: Current endpoint is POST https://ydc-index.io/v1/search (recommended); legacy GET still works but won't get new features; also offers a separate keyless Docs MCP server at you.com/docs/_mcp/server for searching You.com's own docs.

## Web scraping and browser automation [web-scraping-browser]
- Anchor Browser | Provision authenticated cloud browser sessions and turn any website into callable MCP tools for agents. | auth:api_key (anchor-api-key header) | mcp:official https://api.anchorbrowser.io/mcp | $5 free credits/mo, no card required | https://docs.anchorbrowser.io | note: Authenticated (logged-in) browser sessions require a paid tier; free tier covers unauthenticated browsing only.
- Apify | Run web scraping/automation 'Actors' from a marketplace of thousands, and manage datasets, via REST API or MCP server. | auth:api_key+oauth2 (Authorization: Bearer <token> for REST; browser-based OAuth2 or bearer token for hosted MCP) | mcp:official https://docs.apify.com/platform/integrations/mcp | free plan: $5/mo platform usage credit, no card required | https://docs.apify.com/api | note: MCP search/docs tools work unauthenticated; running paid Actors consumes platform usage credit.
- Bright Data | Access Web Unlocker, SERP API, Scraping Browser, and structured datasets via REST API or MCP to pull web data at scale. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer <token>) | mcp:official https://github.com/brightdata/brightdata-mcp | free tier: up to 5,000 requests/mo | https://docs.brightdata.com/introduction | note: Large multi-product suite; pricing and free-tier limits vary significantly by product (Web Unlocker vs Scraping Browser vs Datasets).
- Browse AI API | Trigger pre-built or custom 'robots' to extract and monitor web data via REST API, returning structured JSON. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer <key>) | mcp:none | free forever plan: 50 credits/mo, no card required | https://docs.browse.ai/api/v2
- Browser Use Cloud API | Launch cloud browser sessions and run AI browser-automation agent tasks via REST API or Python/TypeScript SDK. | auth:api_key (X-Browser-Use-API-Key header (key prefix bu_)) | mcp:none | $15 one-time signup credit for new accounts (Google/GitHub/Microsoft); paid usage afterward | https://docs.browser-use.com | note: Pay-as-you-go pricing: browser-hours + per-task fee + token markup; no ongoing free tier beyond signup credit.
- Browserbase (+ Stagehand) | Run and control cloud headless browsers programmatically, with Stagehand adding natural-language page actions. | auth:api_key (X-BB-API-Key header, plus Project ID) | mcp:official https://www.browserbase.com/mcp | free tier: limited browser hours, single concurrency, no card required | https://docs.browserbase.com | note: Billed by browser-hours/compute time; Stagehand SDK itself is open source but needs a browser backend such as Browserbase.
- Diffbot | Automatically extract structured data (articles, products, people) from any URL via REST API, no custom parsing rules needed. | auth:api_key (token= query parameter) | mcp:none | free plan: 10,000 credits/mo, no card required (5 req/min limit) | https://www.diffbot.com/docs/extract/ | note: Also offers Knowledge Graph and Crawl products with separate pricing; official client library docs listed as 'coming soon'.
- Firecrawl | Scrape, crawl, and extract structured data from any website via a single REST API call. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer <fc-key>) | mcp:official https://mcp.firecrawl.dev/v2/mcp | free tier: 1,000 credits/mo, no card required | https://docs.firecrawl.dev | note: Also offers OAuth-based remote MCP endpoint (mcp.firecrawl.dev/v2/mcp-oauth) and a keyless trial with daily limits.
- Hyperbrowser | Spin up cloud browsers and call scrape, crawl, and structured-extract endpoints via REST API or MCP server. | auth:api_key (x-api-key header) | mcp:official https://github.com/hyperbrowserai/mcp | free plan: starter credits, 1 concurrent browser, no card required | https://docs.hyperbrowser.ai | note: SDKs are compatible with Playwright, Puppeteer, and Selenium.
- Oxylabs | Fetch web pages, search-engine results, and e-commerce data at scale via REST API with built-in proxy/unblocking infrastructure. | auth:api_key (HTTP Basic Auth with API-user credentials (--user USERNAME:PASSWORD)) | mcp:none | free trial available (check pricing) | https://developers.oxylabs.io | note: Enterprise-oriented pricing overall, but self-serve API-user creation and free trial are available via the dashboard.
- Playwright MCP (Microsoft) | Official Microsoft MCP server giving agents structured browser control (click, type, navigate) via Playwright's accessibility tree. | auth:none (no auth; runs as a local process via npx) | mcp:official https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-mcp | free, open source, no key | https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-mcp#readme | note: Runs locally/self-hosted via `npx @playwright/mcp`; no cloud hosting, account, or API key required, but needs a local or self-managed browser runtime. Apache-2.0 licensed.
- ScrapeGraphAI API | Use AI-driven prompts to scrape and extract structured data from webpages via REST API or Python/JS SDK. | auth:api_key (API key from dashboard (exact header name not published; check docs)) | mcp:none | free plan: 500 one-time API credits | https://docs.scrapegraphai.com/introduction | note: Also offers the open-source scrapegraph-ai library with LangChain/LlamaIndex integrations.
- ScraperAPI | Scrape any webpage with automatic proxy rotation, CAPTCHA handling, and JS rendering via a single REST API call. | auth:api_key (api_key query parameter) | mcp:none | 5,000 free API credits (trial), no long-term free plan | https://docs.scraperapi.com | note: Widely used alternative to ScrapingBee/Zyte; no official MCP server found.
- Scrapfly | Scrape webpages, run cloud browsers, and capture screenshots via REST API or hosted MCP server with anti-bot bypass. | auth:api_key+oauth2 (key= query param for REST API; API key or OAuth2 for MCP server) | mcp:official https://scrapfly.io/products/mcp-cloud | 1,000 free credits/mo, no card required, no time limit | https://scrapfly.io/docs | note: MCP usage draws from the same credit balance as direct API calls.
- ScrapingBee | Scrape any webpage with JS rendering, proxy rotation, and screenshot capture via a single REST API call. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer <key> (legacy: api_key query param, deprecated)) | mcp:none | 1,000 free API credits, no card required | https://www.scrapingbee.com/documentation/ | note: Postman collection provided in place of a published OpenAPI spec.
- Spider.cloud | Crawl and scrape websites at scale, returning JSON/XML/CSV, via REST API, CLI, or MCP server. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer sk-<key>) | mcp:official https://spider.cloud/mcp/ | keyless trial: 25 free runs/day, no account required | https://spider.cloud/docs/api
- Steel | Create managed cloud browser sessions with stealth proxies and CAPTCHA solving, controllable via REST API or Playwright/Puppeteer. | auth:api_key (Steel-Api-Key header) | mcp:none | Hobby tier: 100 browser-hours/mo, 500 requests/day, no card required | https://docs.steel.dev | note: Open-source self-hostable browser engine (steel-browser) also available; no official MCP server confirmed as of check.
- Zyte API | Fetch and auto-extract web pages (HTML, browser rendering, product/article data) via one HTTP API with ban avoidance. | auth:api_key (HTTP Basic Auth: API key as username, blank password) | mcp:none | $5 free credit for the first month | https://docs.zyte.com/zyte-api/get-started.html | note: Part of Zyte's broader suite (Scrapy Cloud, Zyte IDE).

## Knowledge and research data [knowledge-research]
- arXiv API | Search arXiv preprints by keyword, author, category or ID and retrieve metadata, abstracts and PDF links. | auth:none (no auth) | mcp:community https://github.com/blazickjp/arxiv-mcp-server | free, no key | https://info.arxiv.org/help/api/user-manual.html | note: Endpoint: http://export.arxiv.org/api/query, returns Atom XML. Terms of Use allow no more than one request every three seconds over a single connection. For bulk harvesting use OAI-PMH or bulk data instead.
- Context7 (library docs for agents) | Fetch up-to-date, version-specific library documentation and code examples into a coding agent's context via MCP or REST. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer <ctx7sk_... key> (optional; works at low limits without key)) | mcp:official https://mcp.context7.com/mcp | free; low limits without key, free API key from context7.com/dashboard raises limits | https://context7.com/docs/api-guide | note: Maintained by Upstash; repo https://github.com/upstash/context7. Local server @upstash/context7-mcp, also a ctx7 CLI and @upstash/context7-sdk. REST base URL: https://context7.com/api/. Exceeding the limit returns 429 with Retry-After/RateLimit-* headers. Paid plans cover teams and private repos.
- Crossref REST API | Look up and search scholarly metadata such as DOIs, references, authors, funders and licenses across Crossref-registered works. | auth:none (no key; add mailto=<email> param or User-Agent contact for the 'polite pool') | mcp:community https://github.com/afrise/academic-search-mcp-server | free, no key | https://www.crossref.org/documentation/retrieve-metadata/rest-api/ | note: Base URL https://api.crossref.org (/works, /journals, /funders, /members). Rate limits are adaptive, reported in X-Rate-Limit-Limit/X-Rate-Limit-Interval headers. Identify yourself with mailto for better service. Metadata Plus is a paid SLA tier.
- GDELT API | Full-text search global news in about 65 languages and analyze coverage volume, tone and geography in near real time. | auth:none (no auth) | mcp:community https://github.com/cyanheads/gdelt-mcp-server | free, no key | https://blog.gdeltproject.org/gdelt-doc-2-0-api-debuts/ | note: DOC 2.0 API: https://api.gdeltproject.org/api/v2/doc/doc. Covers a rolling window of about 3 months, max 250 records per query. GEO 2.0 and TV APIs also exist. Full historical Events/GKG data available via Google BigQuery (needs a billed Google Cloud account).
- Hacker News API | Read Hacker News stories, comments, jobs, polls, user profiles and front-page rankings as real-time JSON. | auth:none (no auth) | mcp:community https://github.com/pskill9/hn-server | free, no key | https://github.com/HackerNews/API | note: Base URL https://hacker-news.firebaseio.com/v0/. Read-only, no documented rate limit. No full-text search; use the separate Algolia HN Search API for that.
- NewsAPI | Search and retrieve current and historical news articles and top headlines from thousands of sources worldwide. | auth:api_key (X-Api-Key: <key> header or apiKey=<key> query param) | mcp:community https://github.com/matteoantoci/mcp-newsapi | free Developer plan: 100 req/day, dev/test only, 24h article delay | https://newsapi.org/docs | note: Free plan is barred from staging/production, including internal use; CORS allowed from localhost only. Production use needs the Business plan ($449/mo, 250k req/mo). Endpoints: /v2/everything, /v2/top-headlines.
- OpenAlex API | Query an open catalog of scholarly works, authors, institutions, sources and topics, including citation data, via REST. | auth:api_key (api_key=<key> query param (optional; basic use works without key)) | mcp:community https://github.com/benedict2310/Scientific-Papers-MCP | free: $1 of API usage/day without payment method; free key raises daily budget 10x | https://help.openalex.org/api/ | note: Base URL https://api.openalex.org. docs.openalex.org now redirects to help.openalex.org. Free daily budget resets at midnight UTC; above it, pay-as-you-go with prepaid $1 increments. Annual Member plans start at $5,000/yr. Data is CC0.
- PubMed E-utilities (NCBI) | Search, fetch, summarize and cross-link biomedical literature records from PubMed, PMC and other Entrez databases. | auth:none (optional api_key=<NCBI key> query param; tool and email params recommended) | mcp:community https://github.com/openags/paper-search-mcp | free; 3 req/s without key, 10 req/s with free NCBI API key | https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK25501/ | note: Base URL https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/ (esearch, efetch, esummary, elink). Free API key from NCBI account settings. Run heavy jobs off-peak.
- Semantic Scholar API | Search papers, authors and citation graphs, and get paper recommendations from Semantic Scholar's academic corpus. | auth:api_key (x-api-key: <key> (optional; unauthenticated access allowed)) | mcp:community https://github.com/zongmin-yu/semantic-scholar-fastmcp-mcp-server | free; no key (shared, throttled pool) or free API key on request | https://api.semanticscholar.org/api-docs/ | note: Without a key, all users share a pool of 1000 req/s that can be throttled under load. A key starts at 1 req/s dedicated; requested via web form, arrives by email (not instant). Three APIs: Academic Graph, Recommendations, Datasets.
- Wikidata | Query the Wikidata knowledge graph of entities, facts and relations via SPARQL, the REST API or MCP. | auth:none (no auth for reads (descriptive User-Agent required); OAuth2 Bearer only for edits) | mcp:official https://wd-mcp.wmcloud.org/mcp | free, no key | https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Wikidata:Data_access | note: Official MCP comes from Wikimedia Deutschland (github.com/wmde/WikidataMCP). SPARQL endpoint: https://query.wikidata.org/sparql, query timeout ~60s. REST API at /w/rest.php/wikibase/v1. Wikimedia rate limits and User-Agent policy apply. Added because it's a widely-used structured-knowledge source missing from the candidate list.
- Wikipedia / Wikimedia API | Search, read and summarize Wikipedia and other Wikimedia content and metadata via REST and Action APIs. | auth:none (Reads need no key but require a descriptive User-Agent header with contact info. Optional OAuth2 via Authorization: Bearer <access token> raises rate limits.) | mcp:community https://github.com/Rudra-ravi/wikipedia-mcp | free, no key (rate-limited) | https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Wikimedia_APIs | note: The old API Portal at api.wikimedia.org now 301-redirects to mediawiki.org/wiki/Wikimedia_APIs. Documented limits: 10 req/min for requests identified only by IP, 200 req/min for unauthenticated requests with a proper User-Agent, 2000 req/min for established editors. Main endpoints are the per-wiki MediaWiki Action API (/w/api.php) and REST APIs.
- Wolfram|Alpha API | Get computed answers, structured data and step-by-step results for math, science and factual queries. | auth:api_key (appid=<AppID> query param or Authorization: Bearer <AppID>) | mcp:official https://www.wolfram.com/artificial-intelligence/mcp/cloud/ | free non-commercial developer AppID (reported up to 2,000 calls/month); paid for commercial use | https://products.wolframalpha.com/llm-api/documentation | note: LLM API endpoint https://www.wolframalpha.com/api/v1/llm-api is built for agents; output length set by maxchars (default 6800). Get an AppID via the Developer Portal. Other APIs: Full Results, Simple, Short Answers, Spoken Results. Commercial use requires a paid license. The official MCP is the Wolfram Cloud MCP, covering Wolfram technology broadly.

## Image generation and editing [image-generation]
- Adobe Firefly Services API | Generate and edit images and manage creative assets programmatically via Adobe's Firefly REST APIs. | auth:oauth2 (OAuth2 Server-to-Server (Client ID/Secret via Adobe IMS); Authorization: Bearer <token>, token valid 24h) | mcp:none | check pricing; requires Adobe Developer Console project and Firefly Services entitlement | https://developer.adobe.com/firefly-services/docs/firefly-api/ | note: Enterprise-leaning; needs OAuth Server-to-Server credentials from Adobe Developer Console, not a simple sign-up API key.
- Black Forest Labs FLUX API | Generate, edit, and vary FLUX model images from text prompts via REST or the official OAuth MCP server. | auth:api_key (x-key: <BFL_API_KEY>) | mcp:official https://mcp.bfl.ai | paid only, no free tier (FLUX Schnell weights are open for self-hosting) | https://docs.bfl.ai/quick_start/introduction | note: Official MCP server (flux-mcp) is remote/hosted at mcp.bfl.ai with OAuth-only login, billed to your BFL org.
- Freepik API | Generate and edit images programmatically via REST API, plus access Freepik's stock asset library. | auth:api_key (x-freepik-api-key header (migrating to x-magnific-api-key under Magnific rebrand)) | mcp:none | free tier: ~5 EUR of free API credits, then pay-as-you-go | https://docs.freepik.com | note: Freepik rebranded to Magnific in April 2026; docs/domains and auth header are mid-migration from freepik.com to magnific.com.
- Google Gemini / Imagen image API | Generate and multi-turn edit images from text via REST (Nano Banana/Imagen models), up to 4K with reference-image support. | auth:api_key (x-goog-api-key: $GEMINI_API_KEY) | mcp:none | check pricing (free API key tier exists but image models are mostly usage-billed) | https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/image-generation | note: Also available via Vertex AI for enterprise/cloud_iam auth as an alternative.
- Ideogram API | Generate, edit, remix, upscale, and describe images via REST or an official OAuth MCP server, strong at in-image text. | auth:api_key (Api-Key: <IDEOGRAM_API_KEY>) | mcp:official https://mcp.ideogram.ai/mcp | no free API credits (web app has 10 slow credits/week); API is pay-per-image, $40 min top-up | https://developer.ideogram.ai/ideogram-api/api-setup | note: API billing is separate from Ideogram web subscriptions; requires payment method for API access.
- Leonardo.Ai API | Generate images and videos from text via REST or the official MCP server, with model selection and job status polling. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer <LEONARDO_API_KEY>) | mcp:official https://mcp.leonardo.ai/v1/mcp | $5 free API credits after account verification, then pay-as-you-go | https://docs.leonardo.ai/docs/getting-started | note: Requires a verified account with a payment method to receive API credits.
- OpenAI Images API (gpt-image) | Generate, edit, and iteratively refine images from text prompts via REST, with mask-based inpainting and streaming previews. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer <OPENAI_API_KEY>) | mcp:community https://github.com/SureScaleAI/openai-gpt-image-mcp | paid only; no free image credits, usage-based billing | https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/image-generation | note: Requires an OpenAI API account with billing enabled; part of the Images API / Responses API.
- Recraft API | Generate, edit, upscale, and vectorize images via REST API using Recraft's proprietary models. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer RECRAFT_API_TOKEN) | mcp:official https://github.com/recraft-ai/mcp-recraft-server | paid only; pay-per-image (from $0.007/image on V4.1 Flash), no confirmed free credits | https://www.recraft.ai/docs/api-reference/getting-started | note: REST API, OpenAI-Python-library compatible for some endpoints (not all params supported); official MCP server on GitHub.
- remove.bg API | Remove image backgrounds programmatically via a simple REST API with JSON or multipart uploads. | auth:api_key (X-Api-Key header) | mcp:none | free: 50 API calls/month (preview/small resolution only), then paid credits | https://www.remove.bg/api | note: IMPORTANT: remove.bg API is being discontinued - stops accepting requests on December 1, 2026, with removal moving to Leonardo.ai.
- Stability AI Platform API | Generate, upscale, and edit images via REST (Stable Image Ultra/Core/SD3 models) using simple credit-based billing. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer <STABILITY_API_KEY>) | mcp:none | 25 free credits on signup, then pay-as-you-go | https://platform.stability.ai/docs/api-reference

## Video generation and editing [video-generation]
- Akool API | Generate face-swap, talking avatar, and video-translation content programmatically via REST API. | auth:api_key (x-api-key: <api_key> (or Client ID/Secret to obtain a token, then Authorization: Bearer <token>)) | mcp:none | free Basic plan with limited credits, no card required | https://docs.akool.com | note: Credit-based usage across face swap, avatar video, image generation, video translation endpoints.
- Creatomate API | Programmatically generate and render videos/images from templates via REST API. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer <api_key>) | mcp:none | free trial, 50 API credits | https://creatomate.com/docs/api/rest-api/authentication | note: Per-project API keys; ~14 credits per minute of 720p video.
- D-ID API | Animate photos into talking-head videos with lip-sync from text or audio via REST API. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Basic <api_key> (generated from Account page)) | mcp:official https://docs.d-id.com/mcp | 14-day trial with 3 minutes of video credits, then paid only (~$5.90/min API) | https://docs.d-id.com | note: No permanent free plan; trial has full-screen watermark.
- Google Veo (Gemini API / Vertex AI) | Generate video from text or image prompts via Gemini API (api key) or Vertex AI (cloud IAM), incl. Veo 3.1 scene extension. | auth:api_key+oauth2 (Gemini API: x-goog-api-key header or ?key= param. Vertex AI alternative uses cloud_iam (service-account OAuth2 access token).) | mcp:none | no free tier for video; Veo generation requires a paid Gemini API / Vertex AI billing account | https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/video | note: Same underlying model reachable via two auth paths: Gemini API (simple api_key, good for agents) or Vertex AI (cloud_iam, enterprise/region control).
- HeyGen API | Create AI avatar/talking-head videos from text or audio, manage avatars and voices, via REST API. | auth:api_key+oauth2 (API key: X-Api-Key: <key> (bills to API plan). OAuth2: Authorization: Bearer <token> via https://api2.heygen.com/v1/oauth/token (bills to user's subscription credits).) | mcp:official https://mcp.heygen.com/mcp/v1/ | no free API credits since Feb 2026; pay-as-you-go from $5, $0.50-$0.99/credit. Free plan (3 videos/mo) exists but is for the web app, not standalone API. | https://developers.heygen.com | note: Official remote MCP server uses OAuth (no API key needed) and spends the user's plan credits directly, separate from API-key billing.
- Klap API | Automatically turn long videos into short clips with captions and reframing via REST API. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer <api_key>) | mcp:none | check pricing (no free API tier found; consumer plans from $14/mo, API is usage-based) | https://docs.klap.app | note: Base URL https://api.klap.app/v2.
- Kling AI API | Generate text-to-video, image-to-video, lip-sync and video effects via REST API with JWT-signed requests. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer <JWT> - JWT signed (HS256) client-side from an Access Key/Secret Key pair issued in the Kling Open Platform console) | mcp:community https://github.com/199-mcp/mcp-kling | paid only; prepaid credit packages from $0.14/unit, e.g. 5,000 units/$700, 180-day validity | https://app.klingai.com/global/dev/document-api/quickStart/userManual | note: Auth is JWT built from an Access/Secret key pair, not a static bearer token - more setup than typical API-key services.
- Luma AI Dream Machine API | Generate and extend AI videos from text or start/end keyframe images via async REST API (Ray 2). | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY> (key from platform.lumalabs.ai)) | mcp:official https://github.com/lumalabs/luma-api-mcp | paid only; pay-as-you-go, ~$0.60-$1.05 per 5s clip (Ray 2), $5,000/mo cap on default Build tier | https://docs.lumalabs.ai | note: API credits are separate from Dream Machine subscription credits (do not transfer); failed generations are refunded.
- MiniMax Hailuo API | Async text-to-video, image-to-video and subject-reference video generation via REST API, up to 1080p. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>) | mcp:official https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-MCP | new accounts get 50 signup credits (~1 short clip); 5s video costs ~45-70 credits, 1000 credits=$1 | https://platform.minimax.io/docs/api-reference/video-generation-t2v | note: Region-specific hosts/keys: platform.minimax.io / api.minimax.io vs intl.minimaxi.com for international accounts - key and host must match.
- Mux Video API | Upload, encode, stream and analyse video; get playback URLs, thumbnails and captions via REST. | auth:api_key (HTTP Basic auth: <token_id>:<token_secret>) | mcp:official https://mcp.mux.com | first 100,000 delivered minutes/month free, then usage-based | https://www.mux.com/docs | note: Hosting/streaming infrastructure; does not generate video from prompts.
- PixVerse API | Generate text-to-video, image-to-video, transition and fusion clips (360p-1080p) via REST API. | auth:api_key (API key from platform.pixverse.ai, sent as bearer/header per docs) | mcp:official https://github.com/PixVerseAI/PixVerse-MCP | paid only; prepaid credits from $10, ~$0.28-$0.45 per 5s clip | https://docs.platform.pixverse.ai | note: Developer API credit pool (Essential/Scale/Business) is separate from consumer subscription plans.
- Runway API | Generate and edit images/video (Gen-4.5) via async task-based REST API: submit, poll, download. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY> plus required X-Runway-Version header) | mcp:official https://mcp.runwayml.com/mcp | no free tier; $10 minimum credit top-up, $0.01/credit | https://docs.dev.runwayml.com | note: Docs site also offers /llms-small.txt and /llms-full.txt (not a plain llms.txt). Official MCP also usable from Claude/ChatGPT/Cursor.
- Shotstack API | Compose Edit JSON timelines to programmatically render, edit, and template videos, images and audio. | auth:api_key (x-api-key: <api_key>) | mcp:official https://mcp.shotstack.io/ | 10 free credits (valid 30 days), then pay-as-you-go or subscription | https://shotstack.io/docs/api/ | note: Separate stage (sandbox, watermarked) and production API keys; MCP server is in beta.
- Synthesia API | Generate AI avatar talking-head videos from text scripts via REST API; supports custom avatars and voices. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer <api_key>) | mcp:none | check pricing (no permanent free API tier; paid plans include API minutes) | https://docs.synthesia.io/reference/introduction | note: API access tied to paid plans; base URL https://api.synthesia.io/v2.
- Tavus API | Create AI video replicas and real-time conversational video agents (CVI) via REST API. | auth:api_key (x-api-key: <api_key>) | mcp:official https://mcp.tavus.io/mcp | check pricing | https://docs.tavus.io/api-reference/overview | note: llms_txt found at /llms-full.txt rather than /llms.txt exactly.

## Speech and audio [audio-speech]
- Amazon Polly / Amazon Transcribe (AWS) | Convert text to lifelike speech (Polly) and transcribe audio with speaker diarization (Transcribe) via AWS API. | auth:cloud_iam (AWS SigV4 signing with IAM access keys) | mcp:none | free tier: Polly 5M chars/mo standard, Transcribe 60 min/mo (12 months) | https://docs.aws.amazon.com/polly/latest/dg/what-is.html | note: Needs an AWS account and IAM credentials. Voice and feature availability differs by region. Transcribe docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/dg/what-is.html.
- AssemblyAI API | Transcribe recorded or streaming audio with speaker diarization, sentiment analysis and LLM-based audio insights via REST. | auth:api_key (Authorization: <key> (no Bearer prefix)) | mcp:official https://mcp.assemblyai.com/docs | free tier: $50 credit, no card required | https://www.assemblyai.com/docs | note: The official hosted MCP only searches the documentation. To run transcriptions, call the REST API or an SDK.
- Azure AI Speech | Convert text to speech, transcribe speech to text and translate speech via REST or Speech SDK. | auth:cloud_iam (Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key: <key>, or Authorization: Bearer <Entra token>) | mcp:official https://github.com/microsoft/azure-speech-mcp-server | free tier (F0): 5 audio hrs/mo STT, 0.5M chars/mo neural TTS | https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/ai-services/speech-service/ | note: Now branded 'Azure Speech in Foundry Tools'. Needs an Azure Speech resource, and endpoints are per region.
- Cartesia API | Generate low-latency real-time text-to-speech, transcribe speech and clone voices via REST/WebSocket API. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer <key> plus Cartesia-Version header) | mcp:official https://mcp.cartesia.ai/mcp | free tier: 20,000 credits/mo | https://docs.cartesia.ai | note: The hosted MCP endpoint uses OAuth. The local MCP server is at https://github.com/cartesia-ai/cartesia-mcp.
- Deepgram API | Transcribe batch or streaming audio with diarization, synthesize speech, and run real-time voice agents via REST/WebSocket. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Token <key>) | mcp:official https://github.com/deepgram/mcp | free tier: $200 credit, no card required | https://developers.deepgram.com/reference/deepgram-api-overview
- ElevenLabs API | Generate, clone and stream text-to-speech voices and transcribe audio via REST/WebSocket API. | auth:api_key (xi-api-key: <key>) | mcp:official https://github.com/elevenlabs/elevenlabs-mcp | free plan: limited monthly credits | https://elevenlabs.io/docs/api-reference/introduction | note: Besides the local stdio MCP server, ElevenLabs also offers an official remote MCP endpoint that uses OAuth.
- Google Cloud Text-to-Speech / Speech-to-Text | Synthesize lifelike speech from text and transcribe audio to text via REST/gRPC using GCP credentials. | auth:cloud_iam (API key (?key=) or OAuth2 service-account token: Authorization: Bearer <token>) | mcp:none | free tier: TTS 4M chars/mo standard, STT 60 min/mo | https://cloud.google.com/text-to-speech/docs | note: Requires a GCP project with billing enabled. Speech-to-Text docs are separate: https://cloud.google.com/speech-to-text/docs.
- Hume AI API | Generate expressive text-to-speech and run real-time empathic voice conversations (EVI) via REST/WebSocket. | auth:api_key (X-Hume-Api-Key: <key> (REST); api_key query param (EVI WebSocket)) | mcp:official https://dev.hume.ai/_mcp/server | free plan: 10,000 TTS chars/mo + 5 EVI min/mo | https://dev.hume.ai/docs | note: The free plan allows 1 concurrent connection. Voice cloning is on paid plans.
- Murf AI API | Generate AI voiceovers, clone voices and dub audio in 35+ languages via REST API. | auth:api_key (API key from Murf dashboard) | mcp:none | check pricing | https://murf.ai/api/docs/introduction/overview | note: Two models are offered: Falcon (low latency, for streaming) and Gen2 (studio quality).
- OpenAI Audio API (TTS / transcription) | Synthesize speech with TTS models and transcribe or translate audio with Whisper/GPT-4o transcribe via REST. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer <key>) | mcp:none | paid only (pay-per-use) | https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/audio | note: Whisper transcription costs about $0.006/min. TTS is billed per character or per token, depending on the model.
- Resemble AI API | Synthesize speech, clone voices, convert speech-to-speech and detect deepfake audio via REST API. | auth:api_key (API key from app.resemble.ai dashboard) | mcp:official https://docs.resemble.ai/_mcp/server | pay-as-you-go Flex plan ($0/mo base) | https://docs.resemble.ai/ | note: Enterprise plans are available for on-prem deployment and custom model training.
- Rev AI API | Submit audio for asynchronous or streaming speech-to-text transcription, plus sentiment and topic extraction, via REST. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer <access_token>) | mcp:official https://docs.rev.ai/ | trial credits (about 5 hours of ASR) | https://docs.rev.ai/ | note: The docs site offers an MCP install for Cursor and VS Code, but no remote endpoint URL was confirmed. Human transcription is sold separately as a paid option.
- Speechmatics API | Transcribe audio in batch or real time with speaker diarization across many languages via REST/WebSocket. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer <key>) | mcp:community https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/ArchieMcM234/speechmatics_claude_code_mcp | free tier: 480 min/mo batch transcription | https://docs.speechmatics.com | note: The free tier also includes 2 concurrent real-time sessions. No official vendor MCP server was found.

## 3D generation and assets [3d-generation]
- CSM (Common Sense Machines) API | Create 3D assets and multi-part kits from images via async REST sessions (image-to-3D, retopology). | auth:api_key (API key created from Cube webapp user profile, sent as bearer/header token) | mcp:community https://lobehub.com/mcp/commonsensemachines-blender-mcp | limited free tier (watermarked outputs); full API access is bundled with mid-tier ($19.99+/mo) or higher Cube subscriptions | https://docs.csm.ai/quick-start | note: Async session-based API; monitor completion via webhook (recommended) or polling. A Blender/MCP integration exists but its official vendor-maintained status could not be fully confirmed.
- Hyper3D Rodin API | Generate 3D meshes from text or images (sketch/regular/detail quality tiers) via an async REST job API. | auth:api_key (API key from API dashboard, sent via Authorization header (exact header name in docs)) | mcp:none | 10 starter credits on signup (spent only on downloads, not generation); paid credits $1.5 each | https://developer.hyper3d.ai/api-specification/overview_reset_v | note: Async task-based API: submit generation, then poll or use webhooks to retrieve the finished asset.
- Meshy API | Generate, retexture, rig, and animate 3D models from text or images via REST API or official MCP server. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer <msy-...>) | mcp:official https://github.com/meshy-dev/meshy-mcp-server | free web plan: 100 credits/mo; API key creation requires a paid plan (Pro $20/mo+) | https://docs.meshy.ai/en/api/quick-start | note: Free web accounts get only a limited built-in Playground key; creating/managing your own API keys requires a paid subscription.
- Sketchfab Data API | Search, download, and upload 3D models on Sketchfab programmatically via the REST Data API v3. | auth:api_key+oauth2 (X-API-Key header (personal token) or OAuth2 login; legacy v2 token-in-header also exists but is deprecated) | mcp:community https://github.com/gregkop/sketchfab-mcp-server | free, no key needed for public search; private API token is free with any Sketchfab account | https://sketchfab.com/developers/data-api/v3 | note: This is an asset hosting/marketplace API, not a generative AI model; downloading models generally requires an authenticated Sketchfab account (and often the uploader's permission/license). Use v3 endpoints; v2 is deprecated.
- Stability AI 3D (Stable Fast 3D / SPAR3D) API | Convert a single 2D image into a textured 3D mesh (GLB) via the v2beta/3d REST endpoints. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer <key>) | mcp:none | 25 free credits on signup, then pay-as-you-go (Stable Fast 3D costs 10 credits ~ $0.10/generation) | https://platform.stability.ai/docs/api-reference#tag/3D | note: Endpoints such as POST https://api.stability.ai/v2beta/3d/stable-fast-3d; part of Stability's broader multi-modal Platform API.
- Tencent Hunyuan3D API | Generate textured 3D meshes (GLB, PBR) from text, images, or sketches via Tencent Cloud's Hunyuan 3D API. | auth:cloud_iam (Tencent Cloud SecretId/SecretKey, TC3-HMAC-SHA256 signed requests via the Tencent Cloud API/SDK) | mcp:none | pay-as-you-go from ~$0.02/generation; some enterprise sign-ups get bundled free credits | https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1284/75539 | note: 3d.hunyuan.tencent.com is the consumer web app; programmatic access requires a Tencent Cloud account and the Tencent Cloud API console, not the consumer site directly. An open-source self-hostable model (Hunyuan3D-2.1) is also available on GitHub for those who don't want the managed cloud API.
- Tripo API | Generate textured 3D meshes from text or images via REST API, with an official MCP server for agents. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer <tsk-...>) | mcp:official https://github.com/VAST-AI-Research/tripo-mcp | free/trial credits on signup (amounts and promos change, e.g. ~300 credits/2 weeks); pay-as-you-go at $0.01/credit | https://developers.tripo3d.ai/en/docs/authentication | note: Maintained by VAST AI Research (Tripo's developer). Exact free-credit amounts vary by promotion; verify in console.
