- Klaviyo API | Manage email/SMS marketing profiles, lists, flows, and campaign analytics via Klaviyo's REST API or official MCP server. | auth:api_key+oauth2 (Authorization: Klaviyo-API-Key <private_api_key>) | mcp:official https://mcp.klaviyo.com/mcp | free plan up to 250 contacts / 500 email sends per month | https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/reference/api_overview | note: Official remote MCP at mcp.klaviyo.com/mcp uses OAuth with dynamic client registration; a local MCP server option also exists. Private key scopes cannot be edited after creation.
- Mailchimp Marketing API | Manage email marketing audiences, campaigns, and automation via Mailchimp's Marketing REST API. | auth:api_key+oauth2 (Basic auth 'anystring:<api_key>' or Authorization: Bearer <token>; API key suffix encodes data center (e.g. -us6)) | mcp:none | free plan up to 250 contacts / 500 emails per month (API accessible on free plan) | https://mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/api/root/ | note: No official MCP server found; no widely-adopted community MCP identified. API base URL includes account-specific data-center subdomain.
- Pipedrive API | Create and update deals, contacts (persons/organizations), and activities in a Pipedrive CRM pipeline via REST API. | auth:api_key+oauth2 (api_token query param, or Authorization: Bearer <oauth_token>) | mcp:none | no free tier; 14/30-day trial and free developer sandbox account for testing | https://developers.pipedrive.com/docs/api/v1 | note: No official or notably popular community MCP server found. Offers a free Sandbox account for development/testing separate from production pricing.
- Salesforce APIs | Read and write Salesforce CRM records (leads, opportunities, cases) programmatically via REST, GraphQL, or Bulk API. | auth:oauth2 (Authorization: Bearer <access_token> (OAuth2 web-server / JWT bearer flow)) | mcp:official https://github.com/salesforcecli/mcp | free Developer Edition org available via signup at developer.salesforce.com/signup | https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/apis | note: Official salesforcecli/mcp server is scoped to developer/DevOps tooling (metadata deploy, Apex, LWC) against an authorized org, not a general end-user CRM-data MCP; requires local Salesforce CLI org authorization. Core data access is via REST/GraphQL/Bulk APIs with OAuth2.
- Zendesk API | Create, update, and search support tickets, users, and Help Center articles via Zendesk's REST API. | auth:api_key+oauth2 (Authorization: Bearer <oauth_token> (or Basic {email}/token:{api_token})) | mcp:community https://github.com/reminia/zendesk-mcp-server | free trial (14 days); no permanent free tier, paid Suite plans required for ongoing use | https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ | note: No official Zendesk-maintained MCP server found as of research date; several community MCP servers exist. API tokens can impersonate any account user, including admins.

## Social media [social-media]
- Ayrshare | Unified API to post, schedule, and analyze content across 14+ social networks (X, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, etc.) with one API key. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>) | mcp:official https://www.ayrshare.com | trial credits; no permanent free tier — paid plans required for production use | https://www.ayrshare.com | note: Ayrshare itself holds the underlying per-platform app approvals, so agents avoid individually applying for X/Meta/TikTok developer access. Vendor confirms an MCP server for AI agents; exact endpoint URL not independently verified this session.
- Bluesky / AT Protocol | Post, read, and moderate content on Bluesky via the open, self-hostable AT Protocol REST/XRPC API. | auth:oauth2 (Authorization: Bearer <session/OAuth2 token> (legacy app passwords also supported)) | mcp:none | free, no key needed for public reads; free account required for posting | https://docs.bsky.app | note: Decentralized protocol; official OAuth2 is replacing legacy app passwords as the recommended auth method.
- LinkedIn API | Sign users in and share basic posts via OAuth2/OpenID Connect; most other endpoints require partner approval. | auth:oauth2 (Authorization: Bearer <OAuth2 token>) | mcp:none | check pricing — most scopes require LinkedIn Partner Program approval | https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/ | note: LinkedIn API access is heavily gated; only a narrow self-serve subset (Sign In with LinkedIn/OpenID Connect, basic Share on LinkedIn) is available without applying to a partner program (Marketing, Sales, Talent, Learning solutions).
- Mastodon API | Post statuses, read timelines, and manage accounts on any Mastodon instance via REST API. | auth:oauth2 (Authorization: Bearer <OAuth2 token>) | mcp:none | free, no central key; register an app per instance, no cost | https://docs.joinmastodon.org/api/ | note: Decentralized: each Mastodon instance is its own API endpoint; app registration is per-instance and free.
- Meta Graph API (Facebook, Instagram) | Read and publish posts, manage Pages, and access Instagram business content via Meta's Graph API. | auth:oauth2 (access_token=<token> query param or Authorization: Bearer <token>) | mcp:none | free, but most non-trivial read/write permissions require Meta App Review and business verification | https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api | note: Most useful permissions (posting, Instagram content, insights) require Meta App Review; basic/dev-mode access is limited to admins/testers.
- Pinterest API | Create pins and boards and read analytics data on Pinterest via REST API v5. | auth:oauth2 (Authorization: Bearer <OAuth2 token>) | mcp:none | free tier: standard rate limits; higher limits/trial access require app review | https://developers.pinterest.com/docs/api/v5/
- Reddit API | Read posts/comments and submit posts, comments, or votes on Reddit via OAuth2 REST API. | auth:oauth2 (Authorization: Bearer <OAuth2 token>) | mcp:none | free for non-commercial/personal use under Reddit Data API terms; commercial or high-volume use requires a paid Data API license | https://www.reddit.com/dev/api | note: Since 2023, commercial/high-volume access requires a separate paid Reddit Data API agreement.
- TikTok API | Post videos/drafts and query content on TikTok via the Content Posting and Display OAuth2 REST APIs. | auth:oauth2 (Authorization: Bearer <OAuth2 token>) | mcp:none | free; requires app review for production access, sandbox mode available for testing | https://developers.tiktok.com | note: Apps must pass TikTok's review process before production/unaudited-client-mode access is granted.
- X (Twitter) API | Post, search, and read tweets and manage X (Twitter) content via REST API v2. | auth:api_key+oauth2 (Authorization: Bearer <App Bearer token or OAuth2 user token>) | mcp:none | very limited free tier: write-only, ~500 posts/month, no meaningful read access; paid tiers (Basic $200/mo+) needed for real usage | https://docs.x.com/x-api/introduction | note: Free tier is write-only and extremely restricted; practical agent use (reading timelines/search) generally requires a paid API tier. Docs page returned HTTP 402 during this check, consistent with the paid-access posture.
- YouTube Data API | Search videos, manage playlists/comments, and upload videos to YouTube via REST API. | auth:api_key+oauth2 (key=<API_KEY> for public reads; Authorization: Bearer <OAuth2 token> for writes/private data) | mcp:none | free tier: 10,000 quota units/day (extendable on request) | https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3 | note: Daily quota shared across all calls; different operations cost different quota amounts (e.g. search is expensive).

## Maps, geolocation and weather [maps-geo-weather]
- Geoapify | Geocode, search places, and calculate routes/isochrones via REST APIs built on open geodata. | auth:api_key (apiKey query param) | mcp:community | free tier: 3,000 credits/day (~90,000/month), no card required | https://apidocs.geoapify.com/
- Google Maps Platform | Geocode addresses, get directions/routes, places data, and static/dynamic maps via REST APIs or Google's remote MCP server. | auth:api_key (key query param (OAuth2/IAM for some enterprise/Datasets APIs)) | mcp:official https://mapstools.googleapis.com/mcp | $200 free monthly usage credit across most Maps APIs | https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation | note: Google also has a separate Code Assist MCP (mapscodeassist.googleapis.com/mcp) for docs grounding, distinct from this Maps Grounding Lite data MCP.
- HERE Location Services | Geocode, route, and search places worldwide via REST APIs and SDKs. | auth:api_key (apiKey query param (OAuth2 app tokens also supported)) | mcp:community | free tier: roughly 30,000 transactions/month on the Base/Freemium plan | https://www.here.com/docs | note: Free-tier limits and pricing vary by plan/signup date; confirm current allowance on the dashboard.
- Mapbox | Geocode, route, and render maps/POI search via REST APIs, SDKs, or an official MCP server. | auth:api_key (access_token query param or Bearer token) | mcp:official https://github.com/mapbox/mcp-server | free tier: monthly free quotas per API (e.g. 50,000 map loads/month) | https://docs.mapbox.com/api/ | note: A separate official Mapbox Docs MCP server also exists for documentation Q&A.
- National Weather Service API (NWS) | Fetch official US government weather forecasts, alerts, and observations via a free public REST API. | auth:none (none, but requires a descriptive User-Agent header) | mcp:community | free, no key, no rate-limit tier (fair-use) | https://www.weather.gov/documentation/services-web-api | note: US-only coverage; no API key needed, just a valid User-Agent identifying your app. Missing from candidate list despite being a very commonly used free weather API.
- Open-Meteo | Fetch weather forecasts, historical weather, and climate data worldwide via a free open REST API, no key required. | auth:none (none for non-commercial use; API key + 'customer-' host prefix for commercial tier) | mcp:community | free, no key for non-commercial use (fair-use limits apply) | https://open-meteo.com/en/docs | note: Commercial use requires an API key and the 'customer-api.open-meteo.com' host.
- OpenRouteService | Calculate routes, isochrones, distance matrices, and geocoding over OpenStreetMap data via a free REST API. | auth:api_key (Authorization header with API key) | mcp:community | free tier: ~2,000 requests/day (varies by endpoint), signup required | https://openrouteservice.org/dev/#/api-docs | note: Rate limits vary per endpoint (directions vs isochrones vs matrix); self-hosting also possible.
- OpenStreetMap Nominatim | Geocode and reverse-geocode addresses from OpenStreetMap data via a free public REST API. | auth:none (none, but must send a valid User-Agent/Referer identifying the app) | mcp:community | free, no key; public demo server capped at 1 request/second, bulk use prohibited | https://nominatim.org/release-docs/latest/api/Overview/ | note: Public demo instance is fair-use only (1 req/s, no bulk/systematic queries); self-host or use a commercial provider for production volume.
- OpenWeatherMap API | Fetch current weather, forecasts, and historical/air-quality data for any location via a REST API. | auth:api_key (appid query param) | mcp:community https://github.com/robertn702/mcp-openweathermap | free tier: 1,000 calls/day (60 calls/min) on current weather/forecast | https://openweathermap.org/api | note: One Call API 3.0 has a separate 1,000 calls/day free allotment but requires adding billing details.
- Overpass API (OSM) | Run custom queries (Overpass QL) over OpenStreetMap data - POIs, roads, boundaries - via a public read-only API. | auth:none (none) | mcp:community | free, no key; public instances are fair-use/rate-limited | https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Overpass_API | note: No official SLA; heavy queries can be throttled or time out on public servers.
- Tomorrow.io API | Get hyperlocal weather forecasts, historical data, and alerts for any coordinates via REST API or an official MCP server. | auth:api_key (apikey query param) | mcp:official https://www.pulsemcp.com/servers/tomorrow-io | free tier: 500 requests/day, 3 req/sec, 1 monitored location/alert | https://docs.tomorrow.io | note: No self-serve tier between Free and Enterprise - scaling past free requires a sales call.

## Finance, payments and market data [finance-payments]
- Adyen API | Process payments, payouts, and manage disputes/balances across global payment methods via REST API. | auth:api_key (X-API-Key header (or client-key for client-side)) | mcp:none | paid only; requires a signed merchant contract, pay per-transaction | https://docs.adyen.com/api-explorer/ | note: Requires an approved Adyen merchant account before API keys are issued; no self-serve free signup like Stripe.
- Alpaca Trading API | Place stock/options/crypto trades and stream market data via REST/WebSocket API, with free paper trading. | auth:api_key (APCA-API-KEY-ID + APCA-API-SECRET-KEY headers) | mcp:community | free paper trading (unlimited); free basic (IEX) market data feed | https://docs.alpaca.markets | note: Commission-free live trading requires a funded brokerage account (US persons/entities eligibility rules apply).
- Alpha Vantage | Fetch stock, forex, crypto prices and technical/fundamental indicators via a free REST API. | auth:api_key (apikey query param) | mcp:community | free tier: 25 requests/day | https://www.alphavantage.co/documentation/ | note: Free tier is limited to 25 requests/day; paid Premium plans needed for real-time/higher volume.
- Coinbase (CDP / x402) | Create wallets, send crypto, and pay per-API-call with stablecoins over HTTP (x402) via the Coinbase Developer Platform SDK. | auth:api_key (CDP API Key ID/Secret, JWT-signed bearer requests) | mcp:none | free CDP API access (usage-based fees on some onchain services); x402 is pay-per-request, not a subscription | https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com | note: x402 is an open HTTP-402 payment protocol Coinbase champions, not a single vendor API - useful for agent-to-agent micropayments. No official MCP server confirmed.
- CoinGecko API | Fetch live and historical crypto prices, market data, and NFT data via REST API or the official CoinGecko MCP server. | auth:api_key (x-cg-demo-api-key or x-cg-pro-api-key header; keyless via the free MCP endpoint) | mcp:official https://mcp.api.coingecko.com/mcp | free Demo API plan (~10k calls/month, 30 calls/min); keyless free MCP with shared rate limits | https://docs.coingecko.com/reference/introduction | note: Free MCP endpoint (mcp.api.coingecko.com) requires no key at all, just shared rate limits; a Pro-key MCP endpoint also exists.
- Financial Modeling Prep | Fetch company financials, stock prices, and fundamental data via a REST API. | auth:api_key (apikey query param) | mcp:community | free tier: 250 requests/day (limited endpoints) | https://site.financialmodelingprep.com/developer/docs | note: Many endpoints (full financial statements, etc.) require a paid plan.
- Open Exchange Rates | Fetch current and historical foreign-exchange rates for 200+ currencies via a REST API. | auth:api_key (app_id query param) | mcp:none | free tier: 1,000 requests/month, USD base only, hourly updates | https://docs.openexchangerates.org | note: Free plan is restricted to USD as the base currency; multi-base conversion requires a paid plan.
- PayPal API | Process payments, payouts, invoices, and subscriptions via REST API or PayPal's official MCP server. | auth:api_key+oauth2 (OAuth2 client-credentials Bearer token; MCP also supports an access-token env var) | mcp:official https://mcp.paypal.com | free to integrate; pay per-transaction fees only; sandbox for testing | https://developer.paypal.com/api/rest/ | note: Separate sandbox MCP endpoint at https://mcp.sandbox.paypal.com for testing.
- Plaid API | Link bank accounts and fetch balances, transactions, and identity data via REST API/SDKs. | auth:api_key (PLAID-CLIENT-ID + PLAID-SECRET headers) | mcp:none | free Sandbox/Development access; Production requires approval and has per-item pricing | https://plaid.com/docs/api/ | note: Sandbox is free and unlimited for development; moving to Production requires a Plaid approval/compliance review.
- Polygon.io / Massive | Query real-time and historical stocks, options, forex, and crypto market data via REST/WebSocket API. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer <api_key> or apiKey query param) | mcp:official https://massive.com/docs | free tier available (delayed data, limited calls/min); paid plans for real-time | https://massive.com/docs | note: Polygon.io rebranded to 'Massive' in 2026; the old polygon.io domain now redirects there. Massive also offers an MCP server for AI tools.
- Square API | Process in-person/online payments, manage orders, invoices, and catalog via REST API and SDKs. | auth:oauth2 (Authorization: Bearer <access_token> (personal token or OAuth2)) | mcp:community | free to integrate; pay per-transaction processing fees; free Sandbox for testing | https://developer.squareup.com/reference/square | note: Requires a Square merchant account; Sandbox environment is free for development/testing. Missing from candidate list despite being a major agent-callable payments API.
- Stripe API | Create payments, subscriptions, invoices, and refunds programmatically via REST API or the official Stripe MCP server. | auth:api_key+oauth2 (Authorization: Bearer <secret_key> (or OAuth/Agent key for MCP)) | mcp:official https://mcp.stripe.com | free to integrate; pay per-transaction fees only, no monthly fee | https://docs.stripe.com/api | note: From Oct 31, 2026, Stripe MCP requires an 'Agent' API key or OAuth - full-access/restricted keys without the Agent tag stop working.
- Wise API | Send international transfers, check exchange rates, and manage multi-currency balances via REST API. | auth:api_key+oauth2 (Authorization: Bearer <API token> (personal) or OAuth2 (Wise Platform partners)) | mcp:none | free API access; normal Wise transfer fees apply per transaction; sandbox available | https://docs.wise.com/api-docs | note: Full Wise Platform (send-money-as-a-partner) access requires a partnership agreement; a personal token covers your own account only.

## E-commerce [ecommerce]
- Amazon Selling Partner API | Manage listings, orders, inventory, and reports for an Amazon seller/vendor account via REST API. | auth:oauth2 (LWA (Login with Amazon) OAuth2 access token via x-amz-access-token header) | mcp:none | free API access; requires an existing Amazon Seller/Vendor Central account | https://developer-docs.amazon.com/sp-api/ | note: Self-authorized (private) apps for your own seller account are relatively quick to set up; public apps serving other sellers require Amazon's app-approval review.
- BigCommerce API | Manage catalog, orders, customers, and carts on a BigCommerce store via REST/GraphQL APIs. | auth:api_key+oauth2 (X-Auth-Token header (store API account) or OAuth2 for public apps) | mcp:official https://docs.bigcommerce.com/_mcp/server | free API access; requires an active BigCommerce store plan | https://developer.bigcommerce.com/docs/rest | note: Official MCP server is for documentation search/dev assistance, not direct storefront execution - use API tokens for that.
- eBay APIs | List items, manage orders/inventory, and search listings across eBay marketplaces via REST APIs. | auth:oauth2 (Authorization: Bearer <OAuth2 token> (application or user token)) | mcp:none | free developer tier with call-volume limits; sandbox environment included | https://developer.ebay.com/docs | note: Production access requires an eBay developer account and app keys; rate limits scale with account compliance tier.
- Etsy Open API v3 | List products, manage orders/shop, and search listings on the Etsy marketplace via REST API. | auth:oauth2 (OAuth2 Bearer token + x-api-key header (app keystring)) | mcp:none | free developer keystring (rate-limited, e.g. 10 req/sec, ~5,000 req/day per app by default) | https://developer.etsy.com/documentation/ | note: Requires an approved Etsy developer app; OAuth2 user consent needed for shop-management scopes. Missing from candidate list despite being a major agent-callable marketplace API.
- Printful API | Create print-on-demand products, sync catalogs, and submit fulfillment orders via REST API. | auth:api_key+oauth2 (Authorization: Bearer <token> (Private token or OAuth2 for public apps)) | mcp:none | free API access; pay only for products/fulfillment/shipping ordered | https://developers.printful.com/docs/
- Shopify Admin / Storefront API | Manage products, orders, customers, and inventory (Admin API) or build storefronts (Storefront API) via REST/GraphQL. | auth:api_key+oauth2 (X-Shopify-Access-Token header (custom app token or OAuth2 for public apps)) | mcp:official https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/devmcp | free API access; requires an active paid Shopify store subscription to use | https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-rest | note: The official Dev MCP server helps build/debug Shopify apps via docs & schema search; store operations themselves go through Admin/Storefront API tokens.
- WooCommerce REST API | Manage products, orders, and customers on a self-hosted WooCommerce store via REST API. | auth:api_key (OAuth1.0a signature (HTTP) or Basic auth with Consumer Key/Secret (HTTPS)) | mcp:community | free (self-hosted plugin; no vendor API fees, only your own WordPress hosting costs) | https://woocommerce.github.io/woocommerce-rest-api-docs/ | note: Requires your own WordPress+WooCommerce installation; there is no shared multi-tenant cloud endpoint.

## Automation and integration platforms [automation-integration]
- Activepieces | Build, run and manage no-code flows across 400+ apps via REST API or the built-in MCP server. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer <api_key>) | mcp:official https://www.activepieces.com/docs/mcp/overview | free: open-source, self-hostable at no cost; cloud free plan gives 100 credits/day, no card required | https://www.activepieces.com/docs/endpoints/overview | note: MCP server URL is per-instance (https://your-instance.com/mcp); OAuth-based client auth, and connection secrets/API keys are never exposed through MCP tools.
- Arcade.dev | Execute authorized tool calls (GitHub, Slack, Google, etc.) with managed OAuth via API, SDK, or 200+ MCP servers. | auth:api_key+oauth2 (Authorization: Bearer <api_key>; tool auth uses managed per-provider OAuth (e.g. GitHub, Google)) | mcp:official https://docs.arcade.dev/en/resources/integrations | free tier: 2,000 auth events + 2,000 tool calls/mo, no credit card required | https://docs.arcade.dev/en/home/quickstart | note: First use of an OAuth-gated tool requires the human to approve a browser consent screen; token is then reused automatically. Team plan adds $0.10/auth event and $0.01/tool call beyond free quota.
- Composio | Discover, authorize and execute actions across 1,500+ SaaS toolkits through a unified API, SDK, or MCP session. | auth:api_key+oauth2 (Authorization: Bearer <api_key>; per-toolkit connections use managed OAuth) | mcp:official https://docs.composio.dev/docs/composio-connect | free tier: 100,000 tool calls + 50,000 trigger events/mo, no credit card required | https://docs.composio.dev/docs/quickstart | note: Free plan hard-caps usage with no overage billing; Scale plan ($29/mo) adds per-call overage pricing ($0.0003/tool call).
- Gumloop | Create AI agents, start chat sessions, and trigger no-code automations via REST API, SDKs, or the Gumloop MCP server. | auth:api_key+oauth2 (Authorization: Bearer <api_key>) | mcp:official https://mcp.gumloop.com/gumloop/mcp | 14-day free trial of Pro (20,000 credits), requires credit card, no permanent free tier | https://docs.gumloop.com/api-reference/getting-started | note: Added: missing from the candidate list but a widely used AI-native automation builder with an official API, SDKs, and hosted MCP server. Trial converts to paid Pro ($37/mo) unless cancelled.
- IFTTT API | Fire a webhook event to trigger pre-configured Applets that act in connected consumer apps (Pro plan required). | auth:api_key (Webhooks key in URL path: https://maker.ifttt.com/trigger/{event}/with/key/{key}) | mcp:none | no free-plan access; Webhooks/API require Pro plan ($2.99+/mo) | https://platform.ifttt.com/docs/api_reference | note: Weaker fit than other entries: an agent can only fire events for Applets a human already built in the IFTTT UI (no dynamic/generic action catalog like Zapier), free plan excludes Webhooks entirely, and the Platform/Connect API is aimed at building new IFTTT services, not calling existing consumer integrations.
- Make API / MCP | Trigger and manage Make automation scenarios, or call MCP tools, via REST API and a native MCP server/client. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Token <api_token>) | mcp:official https://www.make.com/en/mcp | free tier: 1,000 operations/mo; most REST API endpoints require a paid plan | https://developers.make.com/api-documentation | note: MCP Server and MCP Client are included free on all Make plans; you pay only for operations consumed when scenarios run. Most REST API endpoints are reserved for paid subscriptions.
- Merge (Agent Handler) | Give an agent governed, audited tool access to Salesforce, Slack, Jira and 100+ enterprise apps via API or MCP. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer <api_key>) | mcp:official https://docs.merge.dev/merge-agent-handler/build/connecting-agents/mcp-integration | free tier: 2,000 monthly credits for evaluation; production usage needs a paid Starter/Business/Enterprise plan | https://docs.merge.dev/merge-agent-handler/overview | note: Separate product from Merge's classic Unified API (HRIS/ATS/CRM sync); Agent Handler is the AI-agent-facing tool-calling layer. Paid tier starts around $650/mo for 10 linked accounts, then per-account pricing.
- n8n API | Create, run and monitor n8n workflows via REST API, and expose or consume tools through MCP trigger/client nodes. | auth:api_key (X-N8N-API-KEY: <api_key>) | mcp:official https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/builtin/core-nodes/n8n-nodes-langchain.mcptrigger | free, self-hosted (open source, unlimited); n8n Cloud offers a paid-plan trial | https://docs.n8n.io/api/ | note: REST API manages workflows/executions/credentials/users, not per-node business logic. MCP support is a first-party node (MCP Server Trigger / MCP Client Tool) inside a running n8n instance, not a single hosted vendor endpoint. Non-Enterprise API keys have full account access; scoped keys need Enterprise plan.
- Nango | Authorize end users to 400+ third-party APIs/MCP servers and proxy authenticated calls to them from your app or agent. | auth:api_key+oauth2 (Authorization: Bearer <secret_key>) | mcp:none | free tier: 10 connections, 10 compute hours, 10GB data transfer/mo | https://nango.dev/docs | note: Nango is primarily an auth/proxy broker (open source, self-hostable) rather than itself an MCP server; its 'MCP Auth' feature lets your app authorize users to OTHER vendors' MCP servers (Notion, HubSpot, etc.) and call them via Nango's proxy. Free self-hosting is not offered outside the Enterprise (BYOC) plan.
- Paragon ActionKit | Call thousands of pre-built Tools and Triggers across 130+ SaaS apps (Slack, Salesforce, Gmail) via API or MCP. | auth:api_key+oauth2 (Authorization: Bearer <token>; connected accounts use managed OAuth) | mcp:official https://www.useparagon.com/mcp | free experimentation tier with self-serve keys; production/scale pricing is usage-based or contract | https://docs.useparagon.com/actionkit/overview | note: ActionKit specifically has a self-serve free tier for experimentation; Paragon's broader embedded-iPaaS platform is contract/sales-only with no public self-serve tier. ActionKit MCP uses SSE transport and is listed on the Anthropic MCP registry.
- Pipedream Connect | Call 2,700+ app APIs and run managed-auth actions on end users' behalf via REST API or Pipedream MCP servers. | auth:api_key+oauth2 (Authorization: Bearer <access_token> (OAuth client-credentials flow recommended)) | mcp:official https://pipedream.com/docs/connect/mcp/developers | check pricing (pipedream.com/pricing) for current Connect free-tier request/credit limits | https://pipedream.com/docs/connect/mcp/developers | note: Requires a Pipedream project plus client ID/secret/project ID to call the MCP server; managed auth handles end-user OAuth for connected apps.
- StackOne | Call 500+ SaaS integrations (HRIS, ATS, CRM, documents) through one unified API or MCP gateway covering 27,000+ actions. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer <stackone_api_key>) | mcp:official https://docs.stackone.com/connect/ai-platforms/overview | free tier: 1,000 action-call credits/seat/mo (Starter), no credit card required | https://docs.stackone.com/docs/getting-started | note: Beyond the free 1,000 credits/seat, Starter bills $0.003/extra call; Core and Enterprise tiers are quote-based (contact sales).
- Superglue | Connect and orchestrate enterprise systems (ERP, CRM, databases) through a self-serve API and per-integration MCP servers. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer <api_key> (exact header not independently confirmed - verify in docs)) | mcp:official https://superglue.ai/docs | free tier: Pro plan free to start, 3,000 executions/mo and 5M tokens/mo included, self-serve signup | https://superglue.ai/docs | note: Added: open-source, self-serve integration/migration agent for enterprise systems (NetSuite, SAP, Sage Intacct, Dynamics) with per-app MCP servers; some exact API details (auth header, SDK) could not be independently confirmed in this pass and should be double-checked in the live docs before use.
- Zapier MCP / AI Actions | Call 9,000+ apps and 40,000+ pre-built actions (Slack, Gmail, Sheets, etc.) through one MCP endpoint. | auth:api_key+oauth2 (Authorization: Bearer <connection_token> (OAuth auto-configured for listed clients like Claude/ChatGPT)) | mcp:official https://mcp.zapier.com/api/v1/connect | Zapier Free plan (100 tasks/mo) covers MCP tool calls; more on paid plans | https://docs.zapier.com/mcp/home | note: "AI Actions"/Natural Language Actions is deprecated; Zapier now steers agents to Zapier MCP. Tool calls consume the same 'tasks' quota as regular Zaps.

## Model APIs and inference [model-inference]
- Anthropic Claude API | Send messages to Claude models for text and vision generation, tool use, batch jobs and document analysis. | auth:api_key (x-api-key: <ANTHROPIC_API_KEY> (plus anthropic-version header)) | mcp:none | paid only | https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/messages | note: docs.anthropic.com and docs.claude.com redirect to platform.claude.com. Rate limits depend on usage tier. The API's MCP connector lets Claude call remote MCP servers; there is no MCP server that wraps the API itself.
- Cohere API | Call chat, embed, rerank and classify endpoints for text generation, semantic search and RAG. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer <COHERE_API_KEY>) | mcp:official https://docs.cohere.com/_mcp/server | free trial key: 1,000 calls/mo, rate-limited | https://docs.cohere.com/reference/about | note: Official MCP server only searches documentation. Trial keys are not for production use. v2 API is current; v1 is legacy.
- DeepSeek API | Send chat and reasoning requests to DeepSeek models via an OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible REST API. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer <DEEPSEEK_API_KEY>) | mcp:none | paid only | https://api-docs.deepseek.com/api/deepseek-api | note: No native SDK: use the OpenAI SDK (base_url https://api.deepseek.com) or the Anthropic SDK (https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic). Off-peak hours (UTC) are discounted.
- fal.ai | Generate images, video, audio and 3D with 1,000+ hosted models via queued REST or real-time WebSocket. | auth:api_key+oauth2 (Authorization: Key <FAL_KEY>) | mcp:official https://mcp.fal.ai/mcp | check pricing | https://fal.ai/docs/model-apis | note: The auth header prefix is 'Key', not 'Bearer'. The MCP server accepts an API key or OAuth. Long jobs use the queue API (submit, status, result).
- Fireworks AI | Run serverless or dedicated inference and fine-tuning for open models via OpenAI-compatible APIs. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer <FIREWORKS_API_KEY>) | mcp:official https://docs.fireworks.ai/mcp | trial credits: $1 on signup | https://docs.fireworks.ai | note: Official MCP server only searches documentation. The Responses API can call external MCP servers as tools.
- Google Gemini API | Generate text and images, analyze multimodal input (video, audio, PDFs), and run code execution with Gemini models. | auth:api_key (x-goog-api-key: <GEMINI_API_KEY> (or ?key= query param)) | mcp:official https://gemini-api-docs-mcp.dev | free tier: rate-limited access to Flash/Pro models | https://ai.google.dev/api | note: Official MCP server only searches documentation; it does not run inference. Free-tier content may be used to improve Google products. Google is replacing standard API keys with authorization keys; unrestricted standard keys are rejected in 2026, so use a current key type. Google publishes a Discovery document, not an OpenAPI spec.
- Groq API | Run fast LLM chat, tool use and speech-to-text on hosted open models via an OpenAI-compatible API. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer <GROQ_API_KEY>) | mcp:none | free tier: rate-limited per model, no card | https://console.groq.com/docs/api-reference | note: Free-tier limits vary by model (e.g. 30 RPM / 1K RPD); see console.groq.com/settings/limits. Not to be confused with xAI Grok.
- Hugging Face Inference Providers | Call hundreds of open-weight chat, vision, image, video and audio models across many providers with one HF token. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer <HF_TOKEN>) | mcp:official https://huggingface.co/mcp | free tier: monthly credits (more with PRO) | https://huggingface.co/docs/inference-providers/index | note: The OpenAI-compatible endpoint (router.huggingface.co/v1) handles chat only; use InferenceClient for other tasks. The token needs the 'Make calls to Inference Providers' scope. Pick a provider with a model suffix such as :fastest or :cheapest.
- Mistral AI API | Run chat completions, embeddings, OCR and document processing with Mistral models via REST. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer <MISTRAL_API_KEY>) | mcp:official https://api.mistral.ai/mcp | free tier: Studio free mode, rate-limited | https://docs.mistral.ai/api | note: Official MCP (same API key) currently exposes only Studio Skills management tools, not chat inference; call the REST API for inference.
- OpenAI API | Generate text, images, audio and embeddings, and run tool-calling via the Responses and Chat Completions APIs. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer <OPENAI_API_KEY>) | mcp:none | paid only | https://developers.openai.com/api/reference/overview | note: Docs moved from platform.openai.com to developers.openai.com (old URLs redirect). Usage-based billing with a payment method; rate limits scale with usage tier. OpenAI MCP docs cover building MCP servers for ChatGPT, not an MCP wrapping the API.
- OpenRouter | Route chat requests to hundreds of LLMs from many providers through one OpenAI-compatible endpoint with fallback. | auth:api_key+oauth2 (Authorization: Bearer <OPENROUTER_API_KEY>) | mcp:official https://mcp.openrouter.ai/mcp | free models: 50 req/day (1,000/day after $10 purchase) | https://openrouter.ai/docs/api-reference/overview | note: The official remote MCP server uses OAuth PKCE and mints a 7-day key with a $10 default spend limit. It includes send-message and generate-image tools. OAuth PKCE is also available for apps.
- PiAPI | Generate images, video and music through one API proxying Midjourney, Flux, Kling and other models. | auth:api_key (X-API-Key: <key>) | mcp:community https://github.com/apinetwork/piapi-mcp-server | trial credits: $0.50 on signup | https://piapi.ai/docs/overview | note: Third-party reseller, not the model owner. The Midjourney access is unofficial, so it can break or violate Midjourney's terms of service. Tasks are async (create task, then poll or webhook).
- Replicate | Run thousands of hosted image, video, audio and text models via HTTP predictions; also fine-tune and deploy. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer <REPLICATE_API_TOKEN>) | mcp:official https://mcp.replicate.com | paid only | https://replicate.com/docs/reference/http | note: Billed per second of compute or per output. The MCP server is also available locally via npx replicate-mcp.
- Together AI | Run serverless inference, batch jobs, fine-tuning and dedicated GPU endpoints for open-source models. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer <TOGETHER_API_KEY>) | mcp:official https://docs.together.ai/mcp | check pricing | https://docs.together.ai | note: Official MCP server only searches documentation. The API is OpenAI-compatible.
- Vercel AI Gateway | Send chat, image, embedding and rerank requests to 100+ models through one gateway with failover and spend tracking. | auth:api_key+oauth2 (Authorization: Bearer <AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY>) | mcp:official https://mcp.vercel.com | free tier: monthly credits on subset of models | https://vercel.com/docs/ai-gateway/sdks-and-apis | note: The base URL https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh works with OpenAI and Anthropic SDKs. Vercel's MCP server is for the whole platform and does not run inference. Tokens have no markup. BYOK requires the paid tier. Free-tier overage returns 429. On Vercel, OIDC tokens can replace the API key.
- Voyage AI (embeddings/rerank) | Generate text, code and multimodal embeddings and rerank documents for RAG and semantic search. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer <VOYAGE_API_KEY>) | mcp:none | free tier: 200M tokens on current models | https://docs.voyageai.com/reference/embeddings-api | note: Owned by MongoDB, but the standalone API at api.voyageai.com is still self-serve. Free tokens do not apply to the Batch API.
- xAI Grok API | Generate text, images, video and voice with Grok models, with built-in web search and code tools. | auth:api_key (Authorization: Bearer <XAI_API_KEY>) | mcp:official https://docs.x.ai/api/mcp | paid only (prepaid credits) | https://docs.x.ai/developers/rest-api-reference/inference | note: The account must have prepaid credits (console.x.ai). The API is OpenAI-compatible (/v1/responses, /v1/chat/completions). Official MCP server only searches documentation.
